name: Half-Square Antenna
description: The Half-Square is a two-element wire array consisting of two vertical quarter-wave legs connected by a horizontal half-wave top wire. It provides strong low-angle radiation ideal for HF DX operation.
modelingNotes: Vertical legs provide the primary low-angle radiation.
Horizontal top wire sets spacing and phase relationship.
Corner feedpoint provides a convenient 50-ohm match.
Height above ground strongly influences takeoff angle.
Mutual coupling between vertical legs shapes the pattern.
End effects adjust electrical length of each segment.
